effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDT0 (0xc2132D…8e8F) from their wallet to the vault, spending that much of their USDT0 allowance to the vault.
The vault mints compUSDT shares to `receiver`; the share count is computed from the vault's stored total assets and supply (floor rounding).
The vault supplies the USDT0 to Morpho Blue markets; no other asset of the signer moves.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the USDT0 amount deposited, the share ticker compUSDT as a constant, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many compUSDT shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0 mints 3 compUSDT to the signer; the screen shows only 'Share ticker: compUSDT'.

findings.title: deposit spends the signer's USDT0 allowance to the vault; the screen does not mention it.
findings.evidence: Case 0: Approval effect USDT0 signer→vault, amount 99997000000 (allowance reduced by 3 USDT0 by transferFrom in ERC4626._deposit). It is the prerequisite of the stated deposit.

cases.notes: 3 USDT0 out to vault is shown right. 3 compUSDT in: asset and receiver shown, amount not. The allowance spend (99997000000 left) is not shown; it is a prerequisite of the deposit.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns compUSDT shares from `owner`; the count is computed from storage with ceil rounding. When the signer is not the owner, it spends the signer's share allowance from the owner.
The vault pulls exactly `assets` USDT0 from Morpho Blue and sends it to `receiver`.
Interest accrual mints fee shares to the fee recipient first; this does not change the USDT0 amount the receiver gets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', 'Withdraw exactly' the USDT0 amount, the receiver ('To') and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many compUSDT shares it burns; the count comes from the vault's storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 1 burns 99.915387006090948522 compUSDT from the signer; no field states the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not name the compUSDT shares that leave the owner; only the USDT0 amount is shown.
findings.evidence: Descriptor withdraw format: fields `assets` 'Withdraw exactly', `receiver` 'To', `owner` 'Owner'; no share ticker, unlike deposit's 'Share ticker' constant field.
findings.fix: Add a constant field labeled 'Shares burned from' with value `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker`, or an interpolatedIntent 'Withdraw {assets} from compUSDT to {receiver}'.

cases.notes: 100 USDT0 in to the signer is shown right. The 99.915 compUSDT burned is not stated; the reader understood vault shares leave, amount unknown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` compUSDT from `owner`; when the signer is not the owner, it spends the signer's share allowance from the owner.
The vault sends USDT0 to `receiver`; the amount is computed from storage with floor rounding, and there is no minimum.
Interest accrual mints fee shares to the fee recipient first, which sets the share price used.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', 'Shares to redeem' as a compUSDT amount, the receiver ('To') and the owner.

findings.title: redeem never names USDT0 as the asset the receiver gets; the reader had to guess it.
findings.evidence: Descriptor redeem format: intent 'Redeem'; fields `shares`, `receiver`, `owner` only. Case 2: signer receives 15.000834 USDT0; reader 'unsure': 'Which token is paid out; USDT is only inferred from the name'.
findings.fix: Add a constant field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, or interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {shares} for USDT0 to {receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDT0 amount received; the vault computes it and enforces no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 2 pays 15.000834 USDT0; no field states it.

cases.notes: 14.991189615730169247 compUSDT out is shown right. 15.000834 USDT0 in to the signer: receiver shown, asset and amount not stated.
